race.title: Ascot Advent Calendar Novices' Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
race.verdict: Preference is for HERBYGOESBANANAS , who opened his hurdles account in good style at Worcester at the beginning of the month. He gets the vote ahead of handicap debutant Baile An Or , with Mr Rafiki another to consider arriving on the back of a breakthrough victory. HERBYGOESBANANAS BAILE AN OR (IRE) MR RAFIKI (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Mr Rafiki (3/1), Herbygoesbananas (7/2), Kilnew Supreme (4/1), Person Of Interest (7/1), Muskerry Rock (8/1), Baile An Or (10/1), Dante's Rocco (10/1), Granite Sands (12/1)
